series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): L sets an ironclad trap against Light before Misa identifies L's true name with Shinigami eyes, only for L to steal Misa's phone and arrest her as the Second Kira.
Prior events (Part 2): L subjects Misa to brutal confinement to extract Kira's identity, driving Rem to wipe Misa's memories and threaten Light with death if he fails to save her.
Prior events (Part 3): Light turns himself into L and demands solitary confinement to execute a daring counter-gamble after Rem threatens his life.
